prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE entirely fresh original BUTCHER character concept for the dark astral science-fantasy game Kindred Siege. Owner's exact new direction: "Towering and inhuman: long proportions, massive hands, visibly transformed anatomy" and "Cold command: rigid authority, anger expressed through absolute control." He is a battle-scarred general and war priest, a trusted inner-circle survivor who stays at camp and forges weapons and gear. This is an appearance proposal, not combat artwork. Start from this brief alone.

FIRST-SECOND IDENTITY:
An immense, unnaturally TALL and elongated alien patriarch-warrior standing completely still. Approximately nine head lengths high. His arms descend below the knees; his two enormous expressive hands are about twice normal proportion. High narrow waist, long powerful legs, deep elongated torso with radically nonhuman rib structure, lean tensile strength under substantial shoulder breadth. He has real mass, not a frail stick figure, and a strongly distinctive outline. Two arms and two legs. Lift the head on a visible long sinewy neck. No rounded belly or huge human pectorals/six-pack. His body has undergone profound astral transformation, not simply a human wearing elaborate armour.

POSE AND PRESENCE:
Perfectly upright, shoulders level, feet firmly spaced, weight balanced. Stillness is his threat. Hands held low and slightly away from his body, fingers deliberately relaxed but bearing huge crushing potential. Chin angled fractionally down, gaze unwavering. A general waiting for an explanation he already knows is inadequate. No shouting, snarling, smile, raised fist, action lunge or feral berserker posing. Face and hands carry cold disciplined anger. No other characters.

LIVING ALIEN FACE:
Create an original exposed, expressive biological face. Broad high brow transitions into a long tapering face of taut layered living nacre and soft membranes, with two deep-set small widely spaced lateral eyes. Swept DOWNWARD cartilage structures frame the cheeks and jaw as part of his anatomy, not horns or a helmet. The face has no protruding human nose or external ears. A small tightly closed mouth sits low, amid several subtle converging skin folds, without exposed teeth. Heavy ancient healed scars pull one side of the face slightly tighter; one eye's lid carries more tension, both eyes functioning. His expression is restrained contempt, perceptive and intelligent. Surface has fine biological creases, soft nacre sheen and slight translucency over dark internal structures. NOT a metal mask, robotic grille, angular square robot head, human head painted purple, reptile, skull, insect mandibles or recognisable franchise creature.
No crown, headgear, halo, transparent brain, forehead eye, third eye, beard or dreadlocks: those identity elements belong to a different locked character.

SKIN AND TRANSFORMED ANATOMY:
Underlying material is beautiful living mother-of-pearl as in his ascended people. His personal palette is COLD SMOKED LILAC and charcoal-purple with black-violet beneath translucent pearlescent skin and very restrained tarnished gold. Clear fleshy biological nacre, not metal, rust, marble or reptile scales. Long uneven ribbons of scar tissue interrupt broad elegant skin surfaces. Chest contains elongated organic arching ribs visible beneath translucent skin, arranged around a narrow dark sternum hollow, no exposed organs. Tendons form long branching structures across his forearms and enormous hands. Some bones have grown dark obsidian reinforcement into the tissue, with small ancient-gold seals embedded at stress points. This is anatomical transformation, not an exosuit.
Hands are the main secondary silhouette: broad strong palms, five elongated heavy jointed fingers on each hand, blackened fingertip pads and fine old forging scars. Obsidian reinforcement grows along backs of hands and forearms while joints remain visibly biological and flexible. No long sharp claws, gauntlet gloves, tools replacing limbs, extra arms, amputations or specific injury story. Delicate craftsmanship and violent strength coexist in these huge hands.
Roughly half the visible surface is exposed skin, a loose design balance. Fully cover groin. No bright emissive skin, galaxy texture, neon eyes or colourful magic.

REBUILD ALL REGALIA:
An original black ceremonial shoulder SHROUD wraps in one broad diagonal line around the back and below one collarbone, leaving the neck, central chest and most arms bare; it falls behind him as a narrow severe vertical cloth mass. It is substantial deep black fabric, with a hint of purple in the folds. No metal shoulder pauldrons, no giant armour suit and no dangling pair of priest stoles. At the waist, an asymmetrical tightly wrapped black garment descends in three restrained broad panels to mid-calf, allowing long leg shapes to remain clear. Only a few polished obsidian plates integrated at pelvis and shins; large quiet surfaces with minimal ancient-gold inlay. A small broken cult seal at the cloth fastening. Scarred, meticulously maintained, austere officer-priest regalia, not flowing wizard robes or medieval knight costume. Keep his silhouette tall and imposing.
No handheld weapon or hammer in this pass: show both immense hands clearly. His forge identity is expressed through the anatomy, old working scars and grown reinforcements. Do not invent a new ability or add a workshop.

DARK ASTRAL PRESENCE:
A restrained charcoal mist leaks along old scars, converges toward his fingers and trails thinly at his ankles. Quiet, tightly controlled and intentional. Never obscure his body. No fire, wings, tentacles, glowing sigils, skull trophies or clouds filling the sheet.

PRESENTATION:
A premium character design painting, refined dark fantasy science fiction with controlled stylization and convincing living material. No chibi proportions, no photoreal cosplay, no action poster, no horror-gore showcase. One complete full-body figure in three-quarter front view occupies the left two thirds of a landscape concept sheet. One matching face-and-neck portrait at upper right shows the SAME perfectly controlled expression and biological surfaces; beneath it one small unobtrusive hand anatomy detail. Cool diffuse key light, warm grey neutral background light enough to separate the black silhouette. Quiet values, rich subtle violet pearl, small ancient-gold accents; crisp shape design with restrained detail. All of the full figure's feet and hands are in frame. Tiny elegant heading "BUTCHER", subheading "WEAPONS / GEAR FORGING". No other text or characters.
inspection: Visually inspected generated full concept sheet: elongated lean alien figure, arms extending below knees, very large hands, bare biological lilac-nacre face with downward cheek structures, controlled closed-mouth gaze, irregular ribs, diagonal black shroud and waist panels, restrained gold/obsidian growth, no hammer, pale violet skin and low dark haze. Strong departure from rejected v2. Limitation: thin legs and narrow palms make him feel more ascetic than physically crushing; fingertip nails read claw-like despite blunt-pad intent; sparse regalia makes general/forger occupation less immediately explicit. Owner review needed, no automatic reroll.
injuryStatus: Exact Sovereign injury remains unselected. Scars and anatomical transformations here are visual proposals, not new injury lore.
scope: One fresh Butcher concept, no image reference inputs. No rejected concept components deliberately carried forward. No leader/Glutton/other Pal changes, PixelLab, sprite production, animation, code/build/Unity work or commits/pushes.
